summary: Proceed as a scored submit, with three build fixes. The fused K row must be RMSNorm'd before /k_scale. A compile failure of the FUSED instantiation must not take V1 down with it. PDL's success or failure must be decided once at import, with no per-call fallback. The in-import V0..V4 gate makes the single judged run readable. The conjecture can only be tested on prepare-time gate numbers: the judge measures one routed variant.
justification: Mechanism is plausible. Master full decode_1 is 22.4 us shape for 20.4 us of kernels (sk two-level 19.0 + pre-attn 1.4; SoL 4.3 us), so ~2 us is node and launch overhead. chunk320 measured 19.49 us shape (A 11.0 + combine 4.5 + pre 1.3). I verified that master's _SPLITKV_CUDA is byte-identical (md5) to the bases of 183eb55, 9b85387 and 2236339, so A and D port onto known code. C removed the pre-attn node on the two-level kernel: judged 21.60 vs 22.40, so about -0.8 us judged and -1.24 us at gate. D has no B=1 evidence: in its source run decode_1 was still on FA3, and B=16 moved only 122.79 to 120.56, within CI. The weakest link is the target of 16.5-17.5 us. C's judged saving was ~0.8 us, not 1.24. In the PDL source, launch_dependents sits AFTER the partial writes, so PDL hides only the combine's launch latency (sub-us), not any of its 4.5 us of work. A realistic V4 is ~18.0-18.8 us judged. That is still a clear decode_1 gain over 22.4 (~-3.6 to -4.4 us x16, roughly +1.0-1.3% headline), but below the stated +1.5-1.8%. A second weak link is that V1 vs V0 was never measured head to head: 19.49 came from an older base and 22.4 from master. The 0.98 gate covers this. The real remaining B=1 cost is the 4.5 us, 16-CTA combine, and neither C nor D touches it. Expected directions are consistent: only FD1 changes, and every other class stays on master byte for byte. Headline readability is poor because full decode_32 noise is large: the untouched decode_32 row moved -8% in the chunk320 run and -5% in the PDL run. Read the full decode_1 row and the PATH CHOSEN / V0..V4 lines, not the headline. Conjecture testability: the judge runs only the routed variant. The V2-V1 and V4-V3 interaction terms therefore come only from the prepare gate pass, where the differences (~0.3-1 us on ~16 us) sit near prepare noise. The builder should print the interaction term (V1-V4) - [(V1-V2)+(V1-V3)] with the per-variant spreads (IQR or p25/p75), so the claim of super-additivity is confirmed or refuted from the log. On the judged profile, also check the expected sequence for V3/V4: no _pre_attention_kernel row, and shape minus kernel sum drops from ~2.7 us. Can the new fused prologue be built correctly without a check run? Yes, conditionally. The import gate checks rel L2 vs the FP32 reference and vs master, compares the stored K/V row bytes (<=3/128 differ, other rows unchanged) and runs the two-state A B B A A B replay. These catch numerical and cache-store errors and fall back to V1/V2 or V0. The judge therefore never sees a wrong FUSED path, but a bug costs the conjecture. The spec as written has one definite bug: it says the new row is built as 'k / k_scale, v / v_scale'. Master _pre_attention_kernel applies the scaleless RMSNorm (eps 1e-5, over the head's 64 entries, per KV head) to K before dividing by k_scale; V gets no norm. Built literally, the stored-row check would fail and V3/V4 would be dropped. Port source C's K path, not the paragraph. Other fused-prologue hazards. (a) The key seq-1 overwrite must land after cp_wait for that stage and before the QK MMA of that tile, for both the K and V rings, with the __syncthreads placed so that no warp is still reading the stage. (b) With one item per CTA (250 items on 264 CTAs), the q build is not hidden behind multiple items as it was in two-level, so V3 > V1 is a real possibility, which the conjecture already admits. (c) The e4m3 cast should use RTNE with saturation (__NV_SATFINITE) to match Triton's float8e4nv on in-range values. Import budget: the job wall was ~489 s on master, so ~75 s more is fine. The 420 s / 120 s / 60 s deadlines bound the added phases to at most ~180 s past 420 s. Since a hung nvcc would not be cut, the worst case stays under the 900 s cap only if master's own benchmark tail stays under ~300 s, which it has.
confounders: full-decode1-streamk-s3-two-level-ticket (landed): this is V0, the incumbent the gate compares against. Its B=1 two-level ticket path is the whole denominator, so the routing decision depends on how fast it is in prepare. No code interaction, because c320 has no tickets and V0 is untouched.
full-decode-cuda-gather-splitkv (landed): supplies _SPLITKV_CUDA, which A and D modify. It is byte-identical to the sources' bases (verified), so the ports are not confounded by drift.

fused-preattention-triton / paired-heads-launch-cleanup-ab-tune-batch-gate (landed): V1/V2 use master's unpaired _pre_attention_kernel at B=1, and V3/V4 must reproduce its K-norm, V-scale and q e4m3 semantics exactly. Any mismatch shows as a stored-row gate failure, not as a speed effect.

restack-sk-pseudo-cluster-plus-v3-fused-preattn (landed skF FUSED_PRE at 1<B<=64): a different fused prologue in a different kernel and module. No runtime interaction at B=1. It matters only as a second, independent implementation of the same fusion that a builder might copy from by mistake (it is the B>1 layout).
Judge noise on full decode_32 / decode_16 (untouched rows that moved -5% to -8% in the chunk320 and PDL runs): the headline can swing either way, independent of this change.
interference: No companion is warranted. Every variant is a separate instantiation behind one config-only FD1 gate. The import gate times V0..V4 interleaved in one cold-L2 pass and prints all five, and PATH CHOSEN names the routed one. A judged gain or loss on full decode_1 is therefore attributable to the named variant against the V0 incumbent, without an extra run. An ab-revert of any landed hypothesis would not change what is measured: master's B=1 path is the comparator, and no landed code is modified. A control that isolates C or D is already built in as V1/V2/V3, at the cost of the conjecture being read from prepare numbers rather than judged ones. Buying a judged V1-only run to attribute it would spend a second scored submit to recover what chunk320's 19.49 us already gives approximately. Process-global flag policy: the hypothesis already replaces the source's static g_pdl toggle with separate PDL and plain host entry points, which complies. Two related requirements: (1) remove the source's per-call 'cudaLaunchKernelEx failed -> cudaGetLastError -> plain launch' fallback from the PDL entry point, because a failed launch inside capture invalidates the capture anyway. Decide PDL availability once at import, via the gate's capture/replay test, and route V2/V4 only if it passed; the PDL entry point then just C10_CUDA_CHECKs the Ex launch. (2) Move the launch_attn 'static bool attr_set' cudaFuncSetAttribute to an explicit import-time init for both A<320,false> and A<320,true>, so nothing in the call path mutates process state, even once. Neither change needs a cell dropped.
rules_flags: FUSED K row: apply scaleless RMSNorm (eps 1e-5, per KV head over D=64) to K before /k_scale and the e4m3 cast, exactly as _pre_attention_kernel does. V gets only /v_scale. The change paragraph omits the K norm. Without it the cache contents are wrong (caught by the gate, but the variant would be lost).

PDL under graph capture: put cudaLaunchAttributeProgrammaticStreamSerialization (programmaticStreamSerializationAllowed=1) on the combine (secondary) launch only. Kernel A is a plain launch issuing griddepcontrol.launch_dependents. The combine must immediately follow A on the same capture stream, with no enqueued op between them (no zero-fill/memset/copy; torch.empty is fine). Combine work that reads A's partials (ws_acc/ws_ml) must come after griddepcontrol.wait. Only inputs complete before A started (qkv gate row, seqlens, v_scale) may be read before the wait. The PDL source placed the wait at the very top; moving reads above it is new code, so keep it to those inputs.
No per-call fallback or static toggle in the PDL path (see interference). Decide at import, freeze in a module bool or MappingProxyType before any capture.

Workspaces ws_acc/ws_ml are torch.empty per call, sized from page_table.shape[1] and batch (shape-only). No module-global pointer may reach into either judge state, and the c320 path has no tickets. Keep it that way: the FUSED owner CTA's cache store uses cache_loc from the call's inputs, never a cached pointer.

Every key attended: the overwritten seq-1 slot must still be consumed by the owner CTA's QK/PV for that tile. Include 1 / 63 / 64 / 4097 / 80000-key cases with seq-1 at a tile boundary and at the last tile of an item (the spec's case list covers most of these; add seq-1 == 319 and 320 relative to the item start).
No timing, prints, try/except or host syncs in kernel_fn. All gate timing stays at import, before the 420 s cutoff logic.
open_questions: Build isolation: if the A<320,FUSED=true> instantiation fails nvcc, the single muse_full_decode_c320 module fails, and V1/V2 are lost with it. Either guard FUSED with a preprocessor macro and, on a build exception, rebuild once without it while the IMPORT_T0 clock is < 420 s, or compile-check the CUDA source locally (nvcc -arch=sm_90a -std=c++20) before submitting. The latter is cheap and should be done regardless, since there is no check run today.

Does the combine's qkv-gate read actually move above griddepcontrol.wait (as the Conjecture claims), or stay below it (as in the PDL source)? State which. Only the former gives D anything beyond launch latency.

launch_dependents placement in A: the source triggers after the partial writes (end of work), so the only overlap is combine launch latency. If an earlier trigger is tried, it is safe for correctness (wait blocks until A fully completes and flushes) but can park 512-thread combine CTAs on SMs. With 264 CTAs at 2/SM there is no free slot except the 14 idle-CTA slots. Keep the source's placement unless the gate shows a reason.

Harvest: compare full decode_1 against 22.4 us (master) and 19.49 us (chunk320 alone). A pass is <= ~19 us with the routed variant named. Read V0..V4 and the printed interaction term from the import log to confirm or refute super-additivity. A judged result near 19.5 us with V3/V4 routed means C and D added nothing on c320.
